Message.text: Cinderdeep Mine. The Miners dug down until they struck a darker place, and left their lanterns burning. The tunnel runs north and down.
A mine cart waits on a rail that runs down the gallery. Stand beside it and press the interact key to ride it down. Press it beside the cart at the bottom to ride back up.
A rail on the gallery's east side, a Miner who has not noticed the cart. Riding is quicker than walking, but you can't fight while you ride.
Cinderdeep Shaft. The tunnel on the north wall leads on, down into Hollowdeep. West, a rail runs into a wall of old timber. East, a corridor glows red.
A loaded cart on a short rail, and the rail ends at a sealed wall that a sword won't break. Press the interact key beside the cart to shove it.
The forge's heat comes down the corridor. Whatever the Miners woke is still working at the anvil.
The tunnel goes on down. Past the next bend the air smells of wet stone and old light.
